title: Classification of cancer cells at the sub-cellular level by phonon microscopy using deep learning.
summary: A CNN learned from phonon-microscopy time-resolved signals distinguished normal MCF10a from cancer MDA-MB-231 cells using elasticity-related measurements; 80 cells across four experimental sessions were split 70/30 for testing. Claim is limited to these in-vitro cell lines. AI role: Convolutional neural network on phonon-microscopy signals. The article appeared in Scientific Reports.
